paite: Huan Naomi in apasal tanau, Elimelek beh, mineizoutak tanau anei a; amin Boaz ahi.
heading: Ruth In Boaz Lou Ah Asem
english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

paite: Moab mi Ruth in Naomi kiang ah, "Lou ah ka va hoh dia, buhsang ka va zong ding aw, hon deihsakmi kuate hiam va tuak moh lou ka hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hoh in, ka tanu," achi hi.
english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”

paite: Huchi in ahohta a, buh la mite lakmaih ava zong a; huchi in Elimelek beh Boaz lou ah ava hoh kha geih hi.
english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

paite: Huchi in ngai in, Bethlehem a pan Boaz ava hoh a, buh la mite kiang ah, “Na kiang uah TOUPA om hen," achi hi. Amau, “TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hen,” chi in adawng uhi.
english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”

paite: Huchi in Boaz in asikha, buh la mite tung a heutu kiang ah, “Hiai kua nungaknou ahia oi?” achi hi.
english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

paite: Abuh la mite tung a heutu asikha in, "Moab nungaknou, Moab gam a pan Naomi toh hong pai ahi.
english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

paite: Ama'n, 'hon hehpih inla, na buhsang ka zong dia, buh la mite'n abuhphal uh alakkhawm khit chiang un ka zong zel ding aw' achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai a, inn a tomchik a-om chih louh zingsang a pan a-om nilouh hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”

paite: Huchi in Boaz in Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, ngai dih, buhsang zong in lou dang ah hoh ke'nla, hiai a pan paisuan ke'n. Ka sikha nungakte kiang ah om gige in.
english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

paite: Abuhlak uh en gige inla, anung uh sui zel in. Tangvalte nang bangmah hon chih lou ding in thu ka pevekta hi. Na dangtak peuh chiang in tuibel a tangvalte tui tawisa dawn zel in," achi hi.
english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

paite: Huchi in akun a, lei si in abokkhup a, akiang ah, "Namdang hinapi ing a, nang hichibang a na hon theihnop a, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan bangchidan ahia?" achi hi.
english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

paite: Boaz in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na pasal sih nungsiah na pi tung a na thilhihdan tengteng mi'n ahon hilh vek uh. Na nu leh na pa leh na pianna gam paisan atum a lam a na mi theih ngeilouhte kiang a na hong paidante leng.
english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

paite: TOUPA'N na thilhih hon din henla, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, kihumbitna dia akha nuai na muan in kipahman tampi hon pia hen," achi hi.
english: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka toupa, na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang a, na hon lungmuan a, na sikha nungakte lak a mi hi kei mah leng, na sikhanu hoihtak in na hon houpihta ngal a,” achi hi.
english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”

paite: An nek hun in Boaz in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, tanghoute hong ne sam inla, tanghou themte uain thuk ah hong diah in,” achi hi. Huchi in buh la mite kiang ah atu a; buhkan apia a; ane a, anek nung in leng akhamval lai hi.
english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She sat beside the reapers, and they passed her parched grain. She ate, was satisfied, and left some of it.

paite: Buhsang zong dia adin nawn in, Boaz in atangvalte kiang ah, "Buhphalte lak ah leng tawmsak zel unla, tai kei un.
english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.

paite: Alomte leng dohkhiaksak unla, nutsiat zel unla, tom henla, tai kei un," chỉ in thu apia hi.
english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”

paite: Huchi in lou a buhsang nitaklam tan in azong hi. Azonsa akhen a, barli buh ephah khat hiamtak apha hi.
english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

paite: Avan kisuan in khopi ah apaita hi. Api in abuhsang zon ana mu a; ama'n anek kham val asitte asuahkhia a, apia hi.
english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.

paite: Api in akiang ah, "Tuni a koilam a buhsang zong na hia? Koi ah ahia na va sep? Ahon na theinuampa vualzawl in om hen," achi hi. Ama'n kua kiang ah ahia ava sep chih api ahilh hi. "Tuni a nna ka va sepna pa min Boaz ahi,” achi hi.
english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, “The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz.”

paite: Naomi in amounu kiang ah, "TOUPA, mihing leh misi tung a ahehpihna tawp tuan ngei lou in amah vualzawl hen,” achi hi. Naomi in akiang ah, "Huai mi, i kinaihpih, i tanau bul ei ve,” achi hi.
english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by Yahweh, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

paite: Moab mi Ruth in, "Kei kiang a leng hon chi ei ve,” achi hi.
english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

paite: Naomi in amounu Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, lou dang a ahon muh hetlouhna ding in asikha nungakte lak ngen ah pai lechin ahoih ding," achi hi.
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”

paite: Huchi in barli buh leh buhpi lak khit mateng Boaz sikha nungakte lak kia ah buhsang zong in ahoh a, api kiang ah ateng hi.
english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.
